notes.subject: interconnect `link-source`
notes.text: Cloud VPN to AWS (landing-zone managed): what kind of link it is isn't recorded (ciamLinkKind): not rendered
how: Record its kind of link (ciamLinkKind), under an approved change, and re-render

notes.subject: flow log `flow-subnets`
notes.text: subnetworks subnet-ds, subnet-pf, subnet-am, subnet-idm, subnet-ig log their flows to Cloud Logging, routed to ops-logs (projects/example-aero-ciam-standby/locations/global/buckets/ciam-ops), kept 30 days there: the log_config isn't rendered here
how: Set the log_config (aggregation_interval INTERVAL_5_SEC, flow_sampling 0.5, metadata INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA) of each subnetwork where it is defined

notes.subject: NAT egress `egress-pf`
notes.text: the subnetworks an existing NAT serves aren't recorded: they stay as they are
